dimensions.assessment: Directly involves federal officials in SelectUSA and State-level economic development organizations across the country.
dimensions.evidence: the Executive Director of SelectUSA shall solicit comments from State-level economic development organizations

dimensions.assessment: Requires information gathering, review, and a report to Congress without altering substantive regulatory or investment disbursement laws directly.
dimensions.evidence: submit ... a report that includes ... a review of the comments SelectUSA received from State-level economic development organizations

dimensions.assessment: Explicitly prohibits the authorization of additional funds to carry out the act.
dimensions.evidence: No additional funds are authorized to be appropriated for the purpose of carrying out this Act.

dimensions.assessment: Directs a specific administrative agency program to conduct a consultation and reporting process.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 2 years after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Executive Director of SelectUSA ... shall submit ... a report

dimensions.assessment: Culminates in a one-time report due two years after enactment, with no permanent new operational program created.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 2 years after the date of the enactment of this Act ... submit ... a report

importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires SelectUSA to solicit comments from state economic development organizations regarding semiconductor manufacturing investment and report back to Congress within two years using existing funds.
